title: The State of Agentic iOS Engineering in 2026
summary: Thomas Ricouard surveys his rapidly changing 2025 workflow for agentic iOS engineering, arguing that AI-driven programming is shifting primary code editing away from Xcode and making continuous tool evaluation part of the job. He frames the article as a broad retrospective on the editors, models, workflows, and opinions that shaped a year of experimentation.
takeaway: Pilot one agent-first editing workflow outside Xcode, document the human review and verification steps that remain essential, and reassess the setup regularly as models and tools change.
